summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community include updates on the integration with Spark, particularly regarding features in Spark 4.1 and 4.2. Additionally, there are ongoing efforts to resolve license issues blocking the Iceberg 1.11.0 and 1.10.2 releases, alongside proposals for fine-grained access policies and enhancements to the v4 specification.
highlights: Proposal for fine-grained access policies in loadTable
Progress on resolving license issues for Iceberg 1.11.0
Discussion on managing partition tuples in Iceberg v4
